overview.title: Team & Access
overview.intro: Members, roles and invitations of this organization, the permissions behind every role, four-eyes requirements and the audit log. Every role is enforced on the server for each action and each assistant tool call.

members.title: Members
members.caption: Members of the organization with role and two-factor state
members.fourEyesHint: Role changes need a second person: saving creates an approval request instead of changing the role directly.

ownerDialog.title: Change the Owner role?
ownerDialog.description: Owners can do everything, including billing, deletion and ownership transfer. Confirm the change for {name} from {from} to {to}.

removeDialog.title: Remove {name}?
removeDialog.description: {email} loses access to this organization immediately. Sites, destinations and data stay. The removal is recorded in the audit log.

permissionsSheet.title: Permissions of {name}
permissionsSheet.description: Role {role}. Permissions come from the role and are checked on the server for every action and every assistant tool call.

invite.title: Invite a member
invite.text: The invitation is sent by e-mail and expires after 7 days. It counts as a seat until it is accepted or cancelled.
invite.seatLimit: Your {plan} plan includes {cap} seats (members plus pending invitations). Remove a member, cancel an invitation or choose a larger plan.

roles.title: Roles and permissions
roles.intro: Six roles, defined once and enforced by the server. The matrix shows exactly which permission each role holds; the permissions sheet of a member shows the same for that person.
roles.customRolesHint: Custom role models beyond these six roles are part of the Enterprise plan.

descriptions.OWNER: Everything, including billing, deletion and ownership transfer. Always an approver.
descriptions.ADMIN: Manages sites, destinations, consent, team, privacy requests and settings; can publish.
descriptions.DEVELOPER: Configures sites, destinations and credentials, publishes and rolls back configurations.
descriptions.ANALYST: Reads events, health and configuration, exports events and uses the assistant read-only.
descriptions.BILLING: Reads everything and manages the subscription and invoices.
descriptions.READ_ONLY: Views only; no changes, no exports.

approvals.title: Approval requirements
approvals.intro: Put risky changes behind a second pair of eyes. A change of a selected type is stored as a request and executed only after a different member with approver rights applies it.
approvals.notInPlan: Approval workflows and the four-eyes principle are part of the Pro plan. Nothing here is enforced in your current plan; the list shows what Pro adds.
approvals.storedInactive: Requirements from an earlier plan are stored. They are kept but not enforced until the plan includes approval workflows.
approvals.notPersisted: The storage for approval requirements is not available yet (migration 0012_team_policies pending). Nothing is enforced.
approvals.readOnly: Your role can view these requirements only.
approvals.changeTypesLegend: Changes that need a second person
approvals.requesterNote: Applies to everyone, owners included: nobody approves their own request.
approvals.enforcementNote: Role changes are enforced here in Team & Access. The other change types are enforced by the module that executes them (Releases, Destinations, Consent & Privacy, Settings) through this same policy; their requests appear in the list above and can be rejected here.

relaxDialog.title: Relax approval requirements?
relaxDialog.description: The following changes reduce protection. They take effect immediately and are recorded in the audit log.

changes.relaxed: {type} no longer needs a second person

config_publish.label: Publish a configuration
config_publish.description: A new tracking configuration goes live for a site environment.

config_rollback.label: Roll back a configuration
config_rollback.description: An earlier version replaces the active configuration.

consent_publish.label: Publish a consent policy
consent_publish.description: A new policy version drives the consent engine for every new event.

credential_change.label: Change credentials
credential_change.description: Storing, rotating or revoking a destination credential.

destination_pause.label: Pause a destination
destination_pause.description: Deliveries to a destination stop while the rest keeps flowing.

member_role_change.label: Change a member role
member_role_change.description: A member receives a different role, including Owner.

kill_switch.label: Kill switch
kill_switch.description: Stops collection and delivery for a site or the whole organization.

requests.title: Open approvals
requests.intro: Changes waiting for a second person. Requests expire after 7 days without a decision.
requests.decidedIn: This change is applied from its own module; here it can only be rejected.

approveDialog.title: Apply this change?
approveDialog.description: You act as the second person. The change is executed immediately and recorded with your name.

rejectDialog.title: Reject this request?
rejectDialog.description: The requester sees the rejection and your note.

audit.title: Audit log
audit.intro: Every recorded change in this organization: who did what, when, on which target. Values are shown redacted; entries can never be edited or deleted.
audit.noPermission: Your role cannot view the audit log
audit.noPermissionText: Ask an owner or admin for the Analyst, Developer or Admin role.
audit.windowLimited: Showing the last {days} days in your {plan} plan. The Pro plan keeps the complete history.
audit.windowFull: Complete history; entries are retained for {days} days.

filters.agent: Track AI (on behalf of a member)

audit.caption: Audit entries, newest first
audit.redacted: Personal data and secrets are redacted before an entry is stored and again when it is shown.
audit.emptyText: Entries appear as soon as someone changes something in this organization.
audit.emptyFilteredText: Widen the range or reset the filters.

notices.roleRequested: The role change was sent for approval. A different member with approver rights has to apply it.

errors.self: You cannot change your own membership.
errors.sameRole: The member already has this role.
errors.confirmOwner: Changes involving the Owner role need confirmation.
errors.lastOwner: The last owner cannot be demoted or removed.
errors.requestExists: An approval request for this member is already open.
errors.alreadyMember: This person is already a member.
errors.alreadyInvited: An invitation for this e-mail is already pending. Resend it from the list.
errors.seatLimit: All seats of your plan are in use.
errors.notInPlan: Approval workflows are not part of your plan.
errors.notPersisted: The storage for approval requirements is not available yet.
errors.notPending: This request is no longer open.
errors.selfApproval: You cannot approve your own request.
errors.notAppliedHere: This change type is applied from its own module.
